battle.name: 第二次直奉戰爭
battle.brief: 第二次直奉戰爭於1924年爆發，直隸與奉天兩軍在北京、天津及山海關一線交戰，最終奉軍攻入北京並控制天津。戰事年代所涉及的地面火力，可對照德軍陸軍的線膛砲，正式型號記為Muzzle-loading field gun，列裝於1850年，早於本場衝突。

kit.name: 線膛砲
kit.history: 線膛砲在德軍陸軍體系中屬野戰砲兵裝備，負責對地面目標提供直射火力支援，並納入步兵協同作戰的火力編組，層級為陸上軍用。

countries: 這場戰爭的兩個交戰主體都在中華民國境內，並非兩個國家。北京方面是曹錕擔任大總統的北京政府，初期由直系吳佩孚掌握中央軍與直魯軍的戰略指揮，馮玉祥所部則仍編在直系軍序內，直到北京政變才轉而控制首都。奉方是張作霖以奉天為中心、掌握東三省軍政與財源的奉系，張學良、張作相、張宗昌等部由錦州及熱河方向入關。日本與奉系在武器、軍事顧問、工業及商運方面往來密切，對奉軍裝備與動員有實際影響，但日本並未以正式交戰國身分參戰；各國駐北京外交人員雖曾設法限制戰事擴大，外國常備軍也沒有進入中國內戰前線。因此，從國際法與戰史分類看，交戰國應記為中國，戰爭主體則是直系與奉系。
countriesEn: The two principal belligerents were both within the Republic of China rather than two separate states. On the Beijing side was the Beijing government under President Cao Kun. At first, Wu Peifu directed the strategic operations of the central and Zhili-Lu armies, while Feng Yuxiang's troops remained incorporated in the Zhili order of battle until the Beijing coup gave him control of the capital. The opposing side was the Fengtian clique under Zhang Zuolin, centered on Mukden and controlling the military, political, and financial resources of the three northeastern provinces. Forces led by Zhang Xueliang, Zhang Zuoxiang, and Zhang Zongchang entered the war from the Jinzhou and Rehe directions. Japan's military, industrial, and commercial contacts with the Fengtian clique materially assisted its equipment and mobilization, but Japan did not participate as a formal belligerent. Diplomats attempted to limit the spread of the fighting, and no foreign regular troops entered the Chinese domestic front. In international and historical classification, the belligerent country was therefore China, while the actual antagonists were the Zhili and Fengtian cliques.
people: 張作霖是奉系最高統帥，也是發動戰爭、批准各路兵力入關及最後進京接管中央政權的核心人物。張學良擔任奉軍東路主要指揮之一，所部是突破山海關方向正面防線的重要力量；張作相掌握中路，張宗昌所部混成旅則是河北戰場與後續山東行動的骨幹，湯玉麟控制的察哈爾奉軍負責西翼。直系方面，吳佩孚是主要統帥，負責直魯軍及北洋中央軍的作戰方向，其指揮中樞最初設於北京。曹錕雖是北京政府大總統，真正捲入軍事崩解的則是吳佩孚率領的直系軍。馮玉祥時任直系第三軍將領，部隊駐紮北京南苑等地；他與張作霖、吳佩孚的立場並非始終一致。十一月三日，馮玉祥控制北京各機關並拘押曹錕，迫使直系失去首都與中央命令權，成為戰局逆轉的決定性人物。
peopleEn: Zhang Zuolin was the supreme commander of the Fengtian clique. He authorized the mobilization, approved the entry of the several columns into China proper, and ultimately entered Beijing to take control of the central government. Zhang Xueliang was one of the principal commanders of the Fengtian eastern route, and his troops formed a major part of the force that broke the frontal defenses in the Shanhaiguan direction. Zhang Zuoxiang commanded the central route, Zhang Zongchang's mixed brigades provided the core of the Hebei fighting and the subsequent campaign in Shandong, and Tang Yulin controlled Fengtian forces in Chahar responsible for the western flank. On the Zhili side, Wu Peifu was the principal commander, directing the Zhili-Lu armies and the former Beiyang central forces from a headquarters in Beijing. Although Cao Kun remained president of the Beijing government, it was Wu Peifu's Zhili military establishment that suffered the principal collapse. Feng Yuxiang, then a commander in the Zhili Third Army with troops stationed around the southern outskirts of Beijing, was not consistently aligned with either Zhang Zuolin or Wu Peifu. On November 3, Feng took control of Beijing's principal institutions and detained Cao Kun, depriving the Zhili faction of the capital and its authority to issue central orders. This action became the decisive political shift in the campaign.
kits: 雙方裝備是清末民初不同來源軍械的累積，並非各自擁有一套完全統一的制式。奉軍步兵常見日製有坂三八式與有坂九九式步槍，也使用德製 Gewehr 98 步槍及一部分漢陽八八式步槍；炮兵主力包括日製四一式七五公厘野炮、四一式七五公厘山炮，以及較舊的八八式、九〇式七五公厘野炮。直軍步兵以漢陽八八式步槍為主要骨幹，部分部隊仍配用日製舊式步槍；炮兵可見施耐德七五公厘 M1907 山炮，也有日製八八式、九〇式野炮。兩軍的炮兵單位均使用過德制十公分 M.18 一類的一二〇公厘迫擊砲。步槍彈並非同一種：日製三八式、九九式使用六點五公厘子彈，Gewehr 98 與漢陽八八式則使用七點九二公厘彈，七五公厘野炮、山炮和迫擊砲亦各有適配砲彈。前線因此必須分別計算彈藥、整備射表、配屬曳引馬匹與車載工具；日製六點五公厘與德製或中國造七點九二公厘的零件不能任意互換。
kitsEn: The equipment of both sides was an accumulation of weapons from different late Qing and early Republican sources rather than a single fully standardized system. Fengtian infantry commonly carried Arisaka Type 38 and Type 99 rifles, but also used German Gewehr 98 rifles and some Hanyang Type 88 rifles. Their artillery included Japanese Type 41 75 mm field guns, Type 41 75 mm mountain guns, and older Type 88 and Type 90 75 mm field guns. Zhili infantry relied chiefly on Hanyang Type 88 rifles, although some units retained older Japanese rifles. Their artillery included Schneider 75 mm M1907 mountain guns and Japanese Type 88 and Type 90 field guns. Both armies also employed German 10 cm M.18 120 mm mortars. Their rifle ammunition was not interchangeable: the Japanese Type 38 and Type 99 used 6.5 mm ammunition, while the Gewehr 98 and Hanyang Type 88 used 7.92 mm ammunition, and field-gun, mountain-gun, and mortar shells were likewise matched to particular weapons. The front therefore had to count ammunition separately, maintain different sighting data, and allocate draft animals and transport equipment by gun type. Japanese 6.5 mm and German or Chinese 7.92 mm components could not be substituted at will.
tactics: 奉軍採取先集中兵力打開山海關，再沿鐵路與公路向北京展開的戰法。張作霖把部隊分為東、中、西三路，東路自錦州指向山海關，中路由朝陽、凌源方向威脅薊縣與平谷，西翼由察哈爾方向監視平綏線，主要打擊仍放在榆關。進攻山海關時，奉軍先以七五公厘野炮與迫擊砲射擊九門口、角山寺、石門寨及榆關外圍的直軍陣位，再由步兵在炮火掩護下反覆攻奪高地；奉軍同時設法切斷直軍由北京向東調兵的道路與鐵路連絡。直軍以師、旅為作戰主體，依托外圍陣地和北京至山海關間的交通線抵抗，並把後方預備隊投入局部反擊，但防線越拉越長，中央預備隊到達各戰線的時間不一。十月突破榆關後，奉軍工兵修復受損鐵路、車站與通信線，炮兵由後方車站分批前移，騎兵和步兵搜索部隊則利用直軍防線裂口向平谷、豐台方向推進。奉軍前鋒抵達北京外圍後沒有立即強攻城垣，主要兵力沿津榆路、平榆路展開。十一月三日馮玉祥在北京倒戈，直軍最高指揮與中央政府同時失去控制，戰役由正面攻防轉為奉軍接防首都、接管機關及追擊吳佩孚殘部。
tacticsEn: The Fengtian plan was to concentrate force at Shanhaiguan and then advance toward Beijing along the railway and roads. Zhang Zuolin divided his forces into eastern, central, and western routes. The eastern force moved from Jinzhou toward Shanhaiguan, the central force threatened Jixian and Pinggu from the Chaoyang and Lingyuan direction, and the western wing in Chahar watched the Ping-Sui railway. The principal effort remained on Yugu. During the attack on Shanhaiguan, Fengtian artillery fired Type 41 75 mm guns and mortars at Zhili positions around Jiulunkou, Jiaoshan Temple, Shimenzhai, and the approaches to Yugu. Infantry then made repeated attacks to seize the heights under artillery cover, while the force attempted to disrupt the Zhili roads and railway connections used to move troops eastward from Beijing. The Zhili army fought with divisions and brigades, resisting from prepared outer positions and the transport line between Beijing and Shanhaiguan. It committed reserves to local counterattacks, but the front continually lengthened and central reserves arrived at different times along the line. After the breach at Yugu in October, Fengtian engineers repaired damaged railway track, stations, and communications. Artillery moved forward in batches from rear depots, while cavalry and infantry patrols exploited gaps in the Zhili line toward Pinggu and Fengtai. On reaching the outskirts of Beijing, the Fengtian vanguard did not immediately assault the city walls; its main columns instead extended along the Tianjin-Yugu and Beijing-Yugu routes. Feng Yuxiang's defection in Beijing on November 3 deprived the Zhili high command and central government of control at once. The campaign then changed from frontal combat to Fengtian occupation of the capital, takeover of government institutions, and pursuit of Wu Peifu's remaining troops.
data: 九月十五日，奉軍先頭部隊在山海關外發動攻擊，炮兵試射很快發展成步兵爭奪九門口與角山寺的地面戰鬥。九月最後數日，直軍仍在榆關外圍抵抗；十月初，奉軍突破直軍外圍防線並控制山海關車站與附近道路。十月十七日前後，奉軍攻取薊縣，沿平榆路向平谷、豐台展開，同時以另一支部隊沿津榆路向天津方向逼近。十月下半月，直軍在豐台外圍投入後方兵力，但此時直系指揮系統已無法統一調度各路，奉軍先頭部隊也未能展開一次有效的總攻。十一月三日，馮玉祥在北京發動政變，控制首都機關並拘押曹錕，直系賴以調兵的中央中樞隨即陷入混亂。十一月四日至五日，奉軍部隊陸續進城接管重要位置；十一月六日，張作霖抵達北京。十一月九日前後，奉軍控制天津，隨後向山東方向追擊吳佩孚殘部，至十一月下旬，吳佩孚喪失北京與天津依托，原直魯軍主力在追擊和地方倒戈中解體。補給方面，奉軍先由錦州經鐵路把部隊、步槍彈、砲彈和糧秣運到山海關，再以火車車站為轉運點，用馬車和汽車把軍需送往西線及南線戰場；直軍雖可利用北京至天津的鐵路短程調兵，卻因山海關方向失守而失去最接近前線的補給樞紐。
dataEn: On September 15, Fengtian vanguard forces attacked outside Shanhaiguan, and the initial artillery fire quickly developed into infantry fighting for Jiulunkou and Jiaoshan Temple. During the final days of September, the Zhili army continued to resist around Yugu. In early October, the Fengtian force broke through the outer defenses, seized Shanhaiguan railway station, and took control of the nearby roads. Around October 17, Fengtian troops captured Jixian and expanded along the Beijing-Yugu road toward Pinggu and Fengtai, while another column advanced along the Tianjin-Yugu route in the direction of Tianjin. In the latter half of October, the Zhili army committed reserves from the rear around Fengtai, but its command system could no longer coordinate all its routes effectively, and the Fengtian vanguard was unable to launch an effective general assault. On November 3, Feng Yuxiang launched the Beijing coup, took control of the capital's institutions, and detained Cao Kun. The central mechanism through which the Zhili forces had been directed immediately became fragmented. On November 4 and 5, Fengtian troops entered the city and occupied important positions. Zhang Zuolin arrived in Beijing on November 6. Around November 9, the Fengtian forces took control of Tianjin and then pursued Wu Peifu's remnants toward Shandong. By late November, Wu had lost the support of Beijing and Tianjin, while the main Zhili-Lu force disintegrated under pursuit and local defections. In the supply system, the Fengtian army first transported troops, rifle ammunition, artillery ammunition, and provisions by rail from Jinzhou to Shanhaiguan. Railway stations then served as transfer points, with wagons and motor vehicles carrying supplies to the central and southern fronts. The Zhili army could use the Beijing-Tianjin railway for short-range movement, but the loss of Shanhaiguan deprived it of the nearest major supply hub to the front.
cause: 第二次直奉戰爭源於一九二二年第一次直奉戰爭後仍未解決的權力分配、軍費來源與鐵路控制問題。張作霖雖在榆關戰敗直軍並退回奉天，卻沒有放棄對東三省、海關收入和京奉鐵路沿線的經營；奉系利用東三省的地盤、煤礦與鐵路收入推行整軍，聘請軍事顧問，擴充混成旅與炮兵，使部隊在訓練、的火力和鐵路動員方面逐漸改善。相對地，北京政府希望削弱奉系的自主軍權，曾以整編、稅務與京奉路權問題向奉系施壓，吳佩孚也在河南、山東與直隸一帶維持直系駐軍，使雙方兵力經常面對接觸。曹錕政府的政治處境更使衝突惡化：他在一九二四年解散國會，準備另行選舉，而張作霖不願看到北京中央權力完全落入曹錕與吳佩孚控制的集團。九月，雙方又在山海關、薊縣和熱河一帶集中兵力，直系增強榆關守備，奉系則把入關作戰視為阻止北京方面先行壓制奉系的手段。最初兵戎相見的地點因此落在山海關，而非遠在奉天的奉系根據地。
causeEn: The Second Zhili-Fengtian War grew from the unresolved division of political power, military revenue, and railway control left after the First Zhili-Fengtian War in 1922. Although Zhang Zuolin had suffered a defeat at Yugu and withdrawn to Mukden, he did not abandon his control over the three northeastern provinces, customs income, and the Beijing-Mukden railway corridor. Fengtian used the territory, coal mines, and railway revenue of Manchuria to reorganize its army, employ military advisers, expand its mixed brigades, and improve training, firepower, and rail mobilization. The Beijing government, conversely, sought to reduce Fengtian autonomy and pressed it over military reorganization, taxation, and rights to the Beijing-Mukden railway. Wu Peifu also maintained Zhili troops in Henan, Shandong, and Zhili, bringing the two forces into frequent contact. Cao Kun's political situation further aggravated the dispute. He dissolved the parliament in 1924 and prepared a new election, while Zhang Zuolin was unwilling to allow central authority to pass entirely into the hands of the Cao Kun-Wu Peifu group. In September, both sides concentrated troops around Shanhaiguan, Jixian, and Rehe. The Zhili reinforced Yugu, and Fengtian treated entry into China proper as a means of preventing Beijing from first reducing the Fengtian position. The clash consequently began at Shanhaiguan rather than in Fengtian's base at Mukden.
impact: 這場戰爭首先改變了北京政府的權力來源。吳佩孚在直魯軍主力受損後失去對中央的實際控制，曹錕退出總統位置，奉軍則藉接管北京與天津取得接近關稅、稅收和中央機關的資源，張作霖由東北軍事強人變成北京政治的核心控制者。然而，奉系並未因此完成對全國的有效統合：河南、湖北、安徽等地仍有直系將領與地方軍隊，馮玉祥在政變後保有自己的政治與軍事立足點，吳佩孚也保有可重新聚集的直系骨幹。對奉系而言，控制線由奉天一路延伸到天津、山東，佔領地與作戰地之間的距離大增，鐵路、軍餉、彈藥和地方財政的負擔隨之上升。山東由奉系部隊進入後，地方軍隊之間的資源與職位分配又形成新的矛盾。對直系而言，軍事信譽與中央名望雖然受挫，地方政治網絡卻未完全消失。這場勝負因此既建立了奉系在北方的優勢，也把北京變成奉系、馮玉祥與各地方實力派必須共同周旋的權力中心。
impactEn: The war first transformed the source of authority in the Beijing government. After the main Zhili-Lu army was damaged, Wu Peifu lost effective control of the center. Cao Kun left the presidency, and the Fengtian army's occupation of Beijing and Tianjin gave the clique access to customs, taxation, and central institutions. Zhang Zuolin consequently changed from a military strongman based in Manchuria into the principal controller of Beijing politics. The war did not, however, produce an effective unification of China. Zhili commanders and local armies remained in Henan, Hubei, Anhui, and other provinces. Feng Yuxiang retained an independent political and military position after the coup, while Wu Peifu preserved the core from which the Zhili forces could later be reassembled. For Fengtian, the controlled line now stretched from Mukden through Tianjin into Shandong, greatly increasing the distances between occupied territory and the fighting zone as well as the burden of railways, pay, ammunition, and local finance. After Fengtian troops entered Shandong, competition over resources and positions created further friction among local military groups. Although the Zhili cliques suffered a loss of military prestige and central authority, their regional political networks remained intact. The result both established Fengtian's predominance in northern China and turned Beijing into a power center in which Fengtian, Feng Yuxiang, and regional commanders had to negotiate with one another.
result: 以九月十五日開戰、十一月上旬決定北京控制權的經過計算，奉系取得明確的戰役勝利。奉軍突破直軍在山海關與薊縣方向的正面防線，推進至豐台外圍；馮玉祥在北京倒戈後，奉軍得以不經攻城戰而接管首都，張作霖於十一月六日抵京。此後奉軍控制天津，並把吳佩孚殘部壓向山東，吳佩孚失去直魯軍主力、直系在北京的中央軍權與原根據地，曹錕的北京政府也隨曹錕被拘而失去原有運作中心。勝方並不是直系，也不是北京政府中的任何原有派系，而是張作霖控制下的奉系軍事力量與新形成的權力組合。這仍不是全國統一：直系在若干省份保有軍隊，奉系對北京以外地區的控制也依賴地方合作者與軍事接防。戰史中各方對每次戰鬥的陣亡、失傷與失蹤數字互不一致，且常把傷病分離報，因此本文不採用未經核實的精確傷亡總數，也不以零散傷數拼成表面精確的總量。
resultEn: Measured from the opening of hostilities on September 15 to the decision over control of Beijing in early November, the campaign produced a clear Fengtian victory. Fengtian broke the Zhili frontal defenses in the Shanhaiguan and Jixian directions and advanced to the outskirts of Fengtai. After Feng Yuxiang turned against the Beijing government in the coup, Fengtian entered the capital without having to assault its walls. Zhang Zuolin arrived on November 6. The Fengtian army then took control of Tianjin and pressed Wu Peifu's remnants toward Shandong. Wu lost the main Zhili-Lu army, the Zhili party's central military authority in Beijing, and its former base, while Cao Kun's detention deprived the old Beijing government structure of its operating center. The victor was neither the Zhili clique nor any existing faction within the Beijing government, but the military force and new governing combination under Zhang Zuolin. This was not national unification. Zhili forces remained in several provinces, and Fengtian control beyond Beijing continued to depend on local cooperation and military occupation. Contemporary accounts gave inconsistent figures for killed, wounded, and missing, often mixing casualties with sick personnel, so this account does not adopt an unverified precise total or combine isolated reports into an apparently exact sum.
